name: dcjack-pj-002ah-smt
description: CUI PJ-002AH-SMT-TR DC power jack, 5.5 mm barrel / 2.0 mm centre pin, 24 V 5 A, SMT with two plastic locating pegs (needs two non-plated holes; check peg length against the board thickness when the back is a heatsink). LCSC C22434687

pins.name: PIN
pins.description: centre pin (terminal 1, two solder tabs) -- the + side of a centre-positive adapter

pins.name: SW
pins.description: switch contact (terminal 2): connected to the sleeve until a plug is inserted; tie to the sleeve net if unused

metadata.rotation_note: footprint has the plug entering from -y; JLCPCB's reel zero-orientation is unverified -- check the placement preview on the first order and record the offset here
